question: Three numbers are in the ratio (1)/(5) : (9)/(18) : (11)/(16) . The difference between the greatest and the smallest numbers is 78. Find the largest number.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert ratio: (1/5) : (9/18) : (11/16)

⇒ (1/5) : (1/2) : (11/16)

LCM of 5, 2, 16 = 80 ⇒ ratio = 16 : 40 : 55

Difference = 55 − 16 = 39 parts = 78

1 part = 2 ⇒ largest = 55 × 2 = 110

**∴ The correct answer = 110**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio = 1/5 : 9/18 : 11/16

Difference between largest and smallest = 78

**Formula Used:**

Multiply ratios by LCM to remove fractions

 
 

 **Term**
 **Fraction**
 **After LCM (80)**
 
 

 First
 1/5
 16

**Calculations:**

⇒ New ratio = 16 : 40 : 55

⇒ Difference = 55 − 16 = 39 parts

⇒ 39 parts = 78 ⇒ 1 part = 2

⇒ Largest number = 55 × 2 = 110

**∴ The correct answer is 110.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fraction Ratio Trick

Convert fractional ratios into whole numbers using LCM

Part Method

Actual value = Ratio part × common multiplier

Difference Concept

Difference in values = difference in ratio parts × multiplier
